 Order

This is a repeat (fourth) application filed by applicant under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.305 of 2022 registered at Police Station Jawad, District Neemuch (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376 and 376 (2) (N) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and also under Sections 5 / 6 and 16 / 17 of Protection of Children From Sexual Officences Act, 2012.

sentences.text: 2. On the last date of hearing i.e. 29.04.2024, status report from the concerned trial Court regarding the progress of the trial was called.
As per status report dated 07.05.2024, out of total eight witnesses, four prosecution witnesses have been examined and the next date of hearing is fixed for 21.05.2024.
3 . After arguing for some on merit of the matter, learned counsel for applicant seeks permission of this Court to withdraw the present bail application.
5. Accordingly, the present case is dismissed as withdrawn.
